name: Massalfassar (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist red with a white farmhouse, the fly white with two blue wavy stripes.
history: The official flag of Massalfassar consists of the same arms of the shield spread over a cloth of twelve parts long by eight wide; the arms and flag were approved by resolution of 15 July 1991 of the Conseller of Public Administration and published in the DOGV of 12 August 1991. The house is a canting sign referring to the etymology of the place name, an old Islamic hamlet.

features.role: two wavy stripes across the fly half
